Hey Coaches,

The Champion Ladder Season 22 of the Cabalvision Official League will start tomorrow February 20th at 12PM CET / 11AM GMT / 6AM EST / 3AM PST!

Congratulations to the winners of Champion Cup 20!

 Bleedinghippy on PC/MAC
 Projjkeke11 on PS4
 Blade2993 on Xbox One
We have some important changes for this new season.

Starting from season 22 and onward, the tiebreaker criterias in the Champion Ladder are:

 Head to head
 Fewest concessions by the coach
 TD difference
 Cas difference

Some of you might know that we did some tests tweaking the maximum TV gap in the matchmaking system. After a few weeks of trial and a close look at the data, we're going back to a maximum TV gap of 500.

We're also switching to a turn duration of two minutes, instead of three, for the Champion Ladder season 22 and onward.

Finally, after nearly two years of prize pool on three platforms and 16 seasons, the Champion Cup 21 will be the last cup featuring a prize pool in cash.

It's not the end of the Champion Ladder. We still have hundreds of coaches and a motivated admin team. Blood Bowl 2 released 3.5 years ago and it's been an exciting ride so far. We're delighted to have such an active community hosting dozens of leagues and sharing their love of Blood Bowl. Thank you so much for that!

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/4k1c8IQ.gif
Hey Coaches,

We're happy to kick-off today the Blood Bowl 2 2018 World Cup Play-Offs!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/d1a1bd767bc5cdb844365986bfe80d8d3463aede.jpg

After months of competition within community leagues and in the official ladder, 64 coaches have qualified for the biggest tournament of the year!

They will compete for more than $30,000 in prizes and become the next Blood Bowl 2 Champion!

Stay tuned to the World Cup!

You'll find below a schedule to watch the matches throughout the World Cup. The semi-finals and finals are officially streamed, but many community streamers will cover the previous round. Make sure to check Twitch's BB2 page not to miss the matches.

All the matches, results and broadcast replays will be available here: http://worldcup.bloodbowl-game.com/score-board

Click here to see the schedule of the matches

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/88cdf445810e1816c3071a1e59cebffe59aa8eb7.png

Rules

The Play-Offs are a 64 player single-elimination tournament starting July 16th 2018. It lasts 4 weeks and finishes August 16th 2018. 

Players qualified for the Play-Offs will create a brand new team with any races available in the game and keep it for the whole competition.
64 teams
Knock-out Single Elimination
All matches in BO1
Three minute turn duration
Resurrection Mode
No Stadium upgrades allowed
No inducement allowed
Custom teams:
Tier 1: Amazon, Bretonnian, Chaos Dwarf, Dark Elves, Dwarf, Lizardmen, Norse, Orc, Skaven, Undead, Wood Elves

Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 4 single skills - maximum 2 skills to one player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1180)

Tier 2: Chaos, Elven Union, High Elves, Humans, Khemri, Necromantic, Nurgle, Underworld, Kislev Circus, Vampire

Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 5 single skills and 1 doubles skill - maximum 2 skills to one player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1230)

Tier 3: Halfling, Goblin, Ogre

Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 4 single skills and 2 doubles skill - maximum 2 skills to one player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1240)

After each game, the advancing coach chooses to place 1 extra skill (Max of 2 skills for T1, T2 and T3 teams still applies) on a specified player.
Round of 64 - as above
Round of 32 - add a doubles skill
Round of 16 - add a normal skill
Quarterfinals - add a doubles skill
Semifinals - add a normal skill
Final - add a normal skill

notes.title: World Cup Invitational 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/d1a1bd767bc5cdb844365986bfe80d8d3463aede.jpg

Hey Coaches,

We're happy to officially launch the 2018 Invitational Cup as the last milestone in the qualifier stage of the Blood Bowl 2 2018 World Cup!

The Invitational Cup is a tournament pitting the best Blood Bowl coaches since the creation of the Champion Ladder (August 2016) - this epic one-time tournament will grant 2 tickets to the World Cup 2018 Play-Offs!

Check the latest results of the World Cup here: http://worldcup.bloodbowl-game.com/score-board

8 Legendary Players
Crucifer
Sean-18
Enarion
Pupok
Diomlord
Arzowane
Bernie Buffon
Rambo2369
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/c76d8c999d830d4ec1725275803ddd71cf3bcac2.jpg

Bracket seeding and predictions by VG Purist and Bernie Buffon.

Dates of the competition
July 4th to July 10th - Invitational Cup Quarter Finals
July 11th - Invitational Cup Semi Finals (exact time to be announced)
July 12th - Invitational Cup Grand Final (exact time to be announced)

Rules

Qualification Rules

The 8 coaches invited to the World Cup Invitational Cup are:
The 5 best coaches from the Champion Ladder PC/Mac from Seasons 1 to 14 and not already qualified for the Play-Offs before the start of the Invitational.
The two best coaches from the Champion Ladder PS4 from Seasons 1 to 14 and not already qualified for the Play-Offs before the start of the Invitational.
The best coach from the Champion Ladder Xbox One from Seasons 6 to 14 (season 6 is the first season of the Champion Ladder on Xbox One) and not already qualified for the Play-Offs before the start of the Invitational.
The best Coaches are those who gained the most points in the 14 Champion Cups according to the following rules:
1 point if the coach reaches the Round of 32 (only valid in seasons 9 to 14)
1 point if the coach reaches the Round of 16
1 point if the coach reaches the Round of 8
1 point if the coach reaches the semi-finals
1 point if the coach reaches the grand final
1 point if the coach wins the Champion Cup
Find the rankings here:
PC/Mac Champion Ladder Rankings
PS4 Champion Ladder Rankings
Xbox One Champion Ladder Rankings

Team Creation Rules

The rules are the same than the World Cup Play-Offs, but without evolution between rounds.

Tier 1: Amazon, Bretonnian, Chaos Dwarf, Dark Elves, Dwarf, Lizardmen, Norse, Orc, Skaven, Undead, Wood Elves
Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 4 single skills - maximum 2 skills per player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1180)
Tier 2: Chaos, Elven Union, High Elves, Humans, Khemri, Necromantic, Nurgle, Underworld, Kislev Circus, Vampire
Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 5 single skills and 1 doubles skill - maximum 2 skills per player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1230)
Tier 3: Halfling, Goblin, Ogre
Team creation up to 1100 TV, then you add: 4 single skills and 2 doubles skill - maximum 2 skills per player. No stat up. (Final Max starting TV: 1240)

Where to watch the matches?

Semi-finals and grand final will be officially broadcasted by VG Purist and The Sage. Make sure to tune in Focus Home's Twitch channel July 11th and 12th!

Of course quarter finals will also be covered by the community - make sure to check your favorite Blood Bowl streamers and youtubers!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/02407d1a4ad28770252f1bd5c14aadd227f1f0d2.jpg

A word from our Champions

Rambo2369

I'm scottish and known in the Xbox community as the smiling assassin due to my tendency to murder teams and my friendly attitude.

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

I play a Vampire team in the Cup, chosen for high str, high ag players with a range of tactical opportunities through hypnotic gaze. Simple, safe build with 4 vampires with block, 1 also with tackle and a leader thrall for 5 RR and and apo.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

I started playing Blood Bowl on Xbox when it came out as it reminded me of Chaos League (a game I loved as a kid), didnt really get hooked until Blood Bowl 2 was released though, as soon as i found the CCL, I've been playing religously ever since! Highlight would be winning the cup in season 9!

A word for your opponents?

I'd just like to apologise in advance and wish them all luck!

Enarion

Avid BB Addict since the late 1980’s. Father of two, 3 and 1, got a wife, house, dog etc. Which means finding time to play BB nowadays is a bit hard.

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

Wood Elves. Simply because it’s the team I enjoy the most to coach closely followed by the little Halfling buggers.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

Sitting in my childhood room playing Blood Bowl vs my friend while “Like a Virgin” was on the repeat. ***Chuckles*** Quite depressing albeit humourus! Been an off and on BB addict ever since.

A word for your opponents?

Good luck and most importantly... have fun! 

Sean-18

Hello my name is Sean. I'm 21 and I'm known in the Blood Bowl community for having hair, something much of the Blood Bowl community can only dream of. I live in the UK and work part time as a bar man and a tutor (drunk people are definitely more annoying than kids).

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

My team is chosen to try and hard counter the biggest threat I will face on my journey in this format. Wood Elves. Dwarves have ample block and tackle which will give me good opportunities to frustrate players with dodge and take them down efficiently without spending any of my valuable 4 skills.

3 Guard both allows me to gain a blocking advantage and to protect my ball from any leap 1 dice attempts on my ball carrier and 2 runners means 2 sets of sure hands for recovering the ball which is where the game will be won and lost. 

With that the added threat of the mighty blow troll slayer should  be the star man not only due to his great hair but his ability to grind down opponents and give me the man advantage that should let me get over the line. My team should still have ample tools to deal with any other bash teams (namely guard and ofc block) I may face but the main focus is to counter wood elves.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

I started playing Blood Bowl when I noticed it advertised on Steam shortly after it came out and I have been fascinated with it in an on/off love/hate way for some time. The premise of turn based strategy with a variety of options that provide different pros and cons with differing success rates is an unsolvable enigma that can be debated on the internet forever.

Shortly after buying the game and playing for a while I discovered Blood Bowl on Twitch by virtue of playing someone who was streaming and decided to take part in the never ending debates about Orc Throwers and Nerves of Steel. It's a fantastic community who are some of the funniest guys you won't meet (because they'll be at home) and there are plenty of opportunities to play and have fun (or watch when you inevitably burn out). 

I ended up streaming a lot of Blood Bowl (and hope I have provided some memorable moments) due more than anything to the community that follows blood bowl on Twitch.

A word for your opponents?

My team is called UNLUCKEEEEE for a reason. If you face me consider yourself UNLUCKEEEEEE. Also if I end up facing Enarion's Wood Elves then sorry not sorry Enarion. 

Diomlord

Hi everyone, I'm Lorenzo alias Diomlord and I'm 26. I live in Italy and in real life i am preparing for the State exam to become a lawyer. I have a girlfriend from Chile that brings me fortune in the game, as I will tell you later.

I have also done a lot of sports in this year, at the moment I am a football referee. I have always played a lot of videogames while in the last few years me and my friends got more near to the tabletop and miniatures games. Then we found that BLOODBOWL IS OUR GAME !!!

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

My main team is and will always be ORC. It all began with Warcraft III and then World of Warcraft (don't know if I can quote them) where my character was "Diomlord", an orc warrior. We played it for some years and then changed a lot of games, but from there I will always bring my nickname and the proud to be an ORC !!!

For the team I will go with: Troll, 4 BOB, 4 blitzers, trower, lineman, goblin + APO and 2 rerolls and 2 Fan Factor; skills will be:  mb blitzer, mb + tackle blitzer, leader trower.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

I started playing about 2 years ago. Starting from the videogame, I found a league here in Pisa that plays tabletop bloodbowl. From that moment i have always played both online and "offline". It's only 2 years but I have a lot of memories that I can tell you: the first tournament won in Lucca one week after the relationship with my girlfriend was started, the "incredible" win of the Champion cup X with the support of my friends, the emotion to win the Dungeonbowl at Dusseldorf, one of the majors and probably the most important tournament in Europe. 

Now that I am the top Orc in the world by NAF rankings, my next goal is to take part at the BB2 WORLD CUP 2018 and do my best there!!!

A word for your opponents?

The words for my opponents are "Rotto senza, CAS, LEVA!!!" that in English mean "broken without (without mighty blow), Casualty, remove (remove the player from the board)!!!"

Pupok

My name is Evgeny and im from Siberia. Playing and streaming Blood Bowl for fun.

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

I choose Humans because its universal strong team for this format. Build with 1 tacke and mass guards.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

Buy this game at september 2015, play a little bit and then have a 2 years break. Then saw this game on a stream and start playing again, and play alot in this year. I won Play-Off of ladder that was best memory in this game.

A word for your opponents?

Just have fun. If you cant find fun in this game delete the game.

Arzowane

I´m a 31 years old spanish player from Barcelona, really addict to strategy games. I´m a psychologist so I know in advance the thoughts of my opponents. I´m so competitive but I like the fair game, and I respect so much my opponents. Always trying to have fun in every match, it´s the only way not to have a heart attack!

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

I have chosen Humans because they can be competitive according to the tournament rules. I tried to balance the team with 3 guards and a killer. I have tried to looked for a team which have access to 12 players and an apo and basic abilities as sure hands, block or tackle. I like humans because they can defend so well with their mobility and score in a few turns if it´s necessary.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

I began playing with the launch of the BB2 for Ps4 and it was love at the first sight! From the beginning of the Cladder I classified in every season and I won it four times with four different teams, being so far the most successful player in PS4. Since the last month I´m also an administrator, knowing that i´m not going to win anymore due to the PS4 admin curse.

A word for your opponents?

Try to enjoy the match, and remember it´s just a game. Love and peace.

Crucifer

I am the guy who plays alot as many people who watch streams call me. Holding the record for most games played in CCL for the reason I really enjoy the game and format.

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

I chose Chaos Dwarves because they are one of two races I play at the moment and pro elves are rather bad at this TV. I thought humans are best but lack of experience with them was a huge problem for me in league World Cup qualifiers. I think it is bad at this tv too so I chose to use experiemental build with 2 RRs and Mino not because I expect it to work, but because I hope it might work.

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

I started playing couple of ears ago and it was like an addiction at first, many restarts, many concedes with orcs and alot of frustration, more than fun actually. Best memory is when I found myself in playoffs first time and first victory in finals, first because of sudden feel of achievement, second because it felt like a huge prize and some kind of glory maybe.

A word for your opponents?

Some of them I almost don't know, some are rivals for very long time now, meaning Pupok and Diomlord. And Enarion is the guy I have most respect for in BB. He was the first guy who I matched against and knew by name. The guy who was the reason I began streaming a year ago and the guy who plays so fast and precise with his elves that it feels like magic.

Bernie Buffon

Hi Everyone My name is Lee aka Bernie Buffon, Nickname The Curse Of Bernie (Due to whatever I tip usually gets diced and goes crashing out of the cup). Im from England and a proud Yorkshiremen Big sports fanatic and favourite sport is American Football. I stream for PS4 and Xbox one mainly Champions ladder and streamed alot of the finals.

What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?

I went with the Oberwalds for purely fun and story purpose really. One season i took a 6 game bret team to the final led by Griff Oberwald and thought it would be fitting to do a human team where his sons all 12 of them (Busy Man) represent me and bring some of that oberwald magic to the invitational. 

Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?

Played Bloodbowl for over 20 years now and love the game, Used to work for games workshop back in the day and loved promoting and teaching people the wonderful game of bloodbowl. 

Best memory is a tough one Turn 25 in opening game of season 1 in first ever champions ladder game where i tried to score turn 25 in overtime and then get knocked out by a tree kicking a penalty goal was funny and from that came Bernie Buffon so i guess that is best memory that is when Bernie Buffon had arrived on the season for all the wrong reasons lol. We still have fun with that today ive just made the season 15 Final with the dwarfs with team called Turn 25 Never Forgotten.

A word for your opponents?

What you gonna do when Bernie Buffon Tips YOU!!!

notes.title: Bug Fixes Update 3.0.210.1
notes.content:
http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/922542965620491567/6ADAC43E9D8FD60EC761C53FA2015DCB7C841718/

We're pleased to announce the release of a new update for Blood Bowl 2 on PC/Mac!

This patch features bug fixes based on your feedback since the release of the last update, a few months ago.

Thanks again for your help!

Update 3.0.210.1

Multiplayer
Fixed a desync issue with the timer that could skip the end of a choice for the active player before it visually ends.
Getting disconnected during the inducements phase will let the player reconnects instead of kicking him on the main menu.
In ladder, the text about added TV during the search for Goblin and Halfling has been removed (the effect itself has been removed in a previous patch).
The reroll timer is now properly displayed for the opponent in multiplayer.
Fixed a bug preventing the browsing of pages in manuel seeding with more than 16 teams.
Player positional names are now displayed in the advanced management screen in multiplayer league.
Fixed an exploit allowing to hire several times the same journeyman.
Fixed an issue during the validation of a multiplayer match against an AI.
To avoid a potential duplicate matchup in Wissen Mode with a low number of coaches, the maximum possible days is now the following:
10 teams : 5 max days
12 teams : 6 max days
14 teams : 7 max days
16 teams : 8 max days
18 teams : 9 max days
20 teams : 10 max days
32 teams : 12 max days
64 teams : 14 max days
128 teams : 16 max days
Skills & Gameplay
Fixed a bug causing the Leader skill to give 2 additional reroll instead of 1 on specific cases.
A player stunned by the "Throw a Rock" event shouldn’t stay one extra turn stunned anymore.
The Wizard spell won’t apply the Mighty Blow bonus on the Armor roll and on the Injury roll.
The Goblin Fanatic isn’t able to use Multiple Block anymore, as written in LRB6.
The Stakes skill should now work properly against the mixed team Afterlife United.
Fixed a potential exploit allowing Throw Team-mate to be used on a player not located next to the thrower.
Fixed a crash caused by an interaction between the skills Blood Lust and Dump-Off.
Improvement of the GUI when the skills Multiple Block and Dauntless interact together.
Rerolling the Chainsaw kickback during a foul now properly checks the Loner skill on the Chainsaw player instead of the fouled one.
Fixed a bug of Throw Team-mate that didn’t trigger a turnover if the thrower player had the ball and land on an opposing player.
Players of the defensive coach won’t use Diving Catch during the kickoff anymore.
Fixed a potential freeze of the game during an interaction between Diving Tackle, Tackle and Dodge with the manuel skills.
Dump-off can now be used during the first turn of the player on offense if the ball has been caught during the Blitz event.
Management
Personal stats reward the thrower for the yards of a pass and not the catcher anymore.
On the post-match dice roll tab, armor/injury rolls have been inverted: for example, the armor roll is noted as Success if the armor didn’t broke. Those rolls are still assigned to the team suffering the block. In addition, Piling On is not considered anymore as a roll on its own but as a standard armor roll.
Singleplayer
Solo saves during a match now save which player did the kick-off in the 1st half-time.
Fixed a blocking issue caused by an AI Leap in some specific cases.
Ageing is off in Eternal League.
Fix of the Resurrection mode in the Franken Cup during an Eternal League.
Improvement of the transition after a defeat in a Knockout competition during an Eternal League.
Graphics
Fixed animations of the Goblin Bombardier which could cause a blocking issue.
The team sponsor now appears on the global roster page.
Fixed a missing arm on Grim Ironjaw during his touchdown celebration.
Fixed a display bug on players hair when they have a helmet.
Team sponsors logo of the Home player are now displayed on the stadium (behind the touchdown line).
Fixed a bug which could prevent the Looney cutscenes to be played.
Fixed animations of Throw Team-mate with the Troll from the Goblin team.
Misc
Decrease of replay files size.
The special introductions of certain Starplayers (Morg, Eldril) from the campaign won’t appear anymore in the others game modes.
The game will now better take into account the preselected square after the block dice choice during a chainpush.

notes.title: Major Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/02407d1a4ad28770252f1bd5c14aadd227f1f0d2.jpg

Hey Coaches,

We're pleased to release a major bug fix update for Blood Bowl 2!

This update should fix most of the remaining technical issues of the game. Thanks for all the feedback and reports we received on our forum, it's been incredibly helpful to deliver this huge patch. Keep them coming!

The official Blood Bowl 2 competition, the Champion Ladder Season 9, will end tomorrow 10.00 AM CEST. Season 10 will start tomorrow around 4.00 PM CEST, after a PC/Mac maintenance. Good luck to all of you!

You'll find the (big) patch note below:

FEATURES
Injuries are now displayed on the player cards.
The Fan Factor is now displayed in the dice log when rolling the FAME.
In the post match recap, the block dice picked by the defender are now displayed in red (as in game).
Two new sponsors are available (cosmetic only).
Mid-match saves aren't deleted when loading the match anymore, but at the end of the game.
GAME MODES

Eternal League
The skills from players in AI teams are now properly taken into account in the team TV. Not retroactive.
The AI now also picks Bretonnia, Chaos Dwarf, Vampire, Kislev and Underworld teams.
Fix of an issue displayed GFIs during AI movements.
Fix of an issue preventing the AI from adapting its TV to the player TV.
Fix of the statistic tab of teams playing in an Eternal League.
Fix of an issue in the "Play in a League" menu after a season change.
Fix of a blocking issue when a coach leaves an on-going wissen competition.
Multiplayer
The pairing in a Wissen competition starts now with the best ranked teams in the leaderboard.
Game played in resurrection mode don't award SPP and gold anymore.
The winnings window shouldn't be displayed anymore at the end of a game in resurrection mode.
The tie-breaker in Round-Robin and Wissen competitions is now:
TD difference > Number of TD > Random
GAMEPLAY
Fix of a blocking issue when ignoring the apothecary during the kick-off event Throw A Rock.
Fix of a desync of the ball after a fireball combined with a scatter out of the pitch.
Fix of a bug causing KO rolls during Overtime to be rolled twice.
Fix of a bug causing Sweltering Heat rolls during Overtime to be rolled twice.
Fix of an issue skipping the coin toss at the beginning at overtime.
Fix of a bug allowing the player to use team reroll to catch the ball during Blitz! kick-off event.
A player loosing a stat point when already at the minimum now misses the next game.
Fix of an issue allowing to choose any skill on a big guy level up.
Fix of an issue allowing to hire any player from any race in a standard team.
Fix of an issue allowing to have too many skills on a level 2 mercenary.
STABILITY
Fix of a crash when reconnecting in a match.
Fix of various crashes in replays.
Level 2 mercenaries shouldn't cause blocking issues anymore.
Fix of various issues and crashes.
GUI
Fix of the % of players coming back from a KO in the post-match recap.
Fix of an issue blocking a player in the settings when the opponent pauses the game.
The planning of a competition is now properly updated after a mnual seeding.
Fix of a bug pausing the game when saving a starting set-up.
The halfling chef pop-up is now properly displayed at the beginning of the second half time.
The SPP gained before a save & quit won't be displayed at the wrong time anymore after reloading.
[MAC] The cyrillic characters are now properly displayed when the game isn't set up in russian.
SKILLS

Pass Block
The game now takes properly into account the square of the thrower, even if he moved in the turn.
Bombardier
Fix of a crash when rerolling a bomb reception.
You can't use Bombardier after Jump Up anymore.
You can't use Hail Mary Bomb during a Blizzard anymore.
Juggernaut
Juggernaut now properly cancels the opponent Wrestle when blitzing.
Juggernaut isn't displayed anymore in the dice recap at the end of the match.
Diving Tackle
The malus of Diving Tackle is now properly applied when using Dodge in manual mode.
Leader
Leader reroll cannot be canceled anymore by the Hafling Master Chef inducement.
Leader reroll is now properly removed when the player with the skill is crowdsurfed.
Leap
Fix of an issue causing the game to roll two GFIs instead of one when a GFI is needed for a Leap.
Really Stupid
A player with Really Stupid skill cannot help the roll of another Really Stupid player.
The bonus brought by a teammate (+2) is now properly displayed in the detailed dice log.
Blood Lust
Blitz isn't used anymore if it is followed by the bite of a teammate.
When triggering "Bite a Teammate" with a vampire, he now gets up automatically before biting.
Prehensile Tail
The penalties are now added if several playerd with Prehensive Tail are next to a player dodging.
Chainsaw
It's now possible to reroll the Kick Back roll of a Chainsaw when fouling.
Ball&Chain
Improved game behaviour if the turn ends when the fanatic has some mandatory movements left.
Fix of a bug preventing players from rolling a ball reception if it scatters because of Ball&Chain.
The fanatic is now properly removed from the pitch after a KO on a Both Down.
Fix of a blocking issue when a fanatic rolls 2 red dice against a teammate.
Right Stuff
The player now properly spend 3 movement points to get up if he landed on an opponent player.
Fix of a bug causing a turnover when a player lands on the ball on the pitch.
Stab
When blitzing, refusing to use Stab on the second block of Frenzy doesn't end the player action anymore if (s)he has some movement points left.
Multiple Block
It's not possible anymore to use the second block of Multiple Block after a Piling On.
The strength bonus given to the defender when using Multiple Block is now properly taken into account when combined with Dauntless.
Strip Ball
The skill is properly activated even when the ball carrier is pushed on a player using Stand Firm.
Disturbing Presence
Harmonization of the effect displayed:
In multiplayer - always blue for the player and red for the opponent.
In local - always blue for P1 and red for P2.
TEAMS

Nurgle
Nurgle Beast mutations are now back and displayed properly.
Nurgle Beast should now stay quiet when not moving.
Orc
The Blitzers now have sounds (they're mainly shouting).
Kislev
Fix of an issue on the random name of the bear in russian, german, spanish and polish. Not retroactive.
Goblin
The Pogoer's 3D model should now be displayed properly when he's MVP.
Khemri
Khemri AI teams shouldn't be able to buy apothecaries. Not retroactive.
Starplayers
Fix of a crash when throwing the Star Player Bomber.
It's not possible anymore to hire Brick & Grotty when there are already 15 players in the roster.
Mixed Teams
Fix of a display issue on the stats of mixed teams players in the customization screen.
The Necromancer is now available for Afterlife United.
Custom Teams
Adding an injury to a player in the Team Editor doesn't add him a level anymore.

notes.title: Legendary Launch Trailer
notes.content:
https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/36/2/1504604485-bb2le-touchdown-bear.gif

Blood Bowl 2 welcomes its Legendary Edition! 

Before stepping onto the pitch, take a look at the Legendary Edition Launch Trailer.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=beqNQTfvdxY
The Legendary Edition offers 24 races, including the sly Goblins and a brand new race - the Kislev Circus and their ferocious Tame Bears! These 24 teams come with all their Star Players, as well as the new Khemri stadium, located at the feet of the Tomb Kings’ imposing pyramids. 

Experience new game modes such as a brand new Solo Career mode, or the new Challenge mode, which will put your wits and skills to the test through crazy and challenging game situations. 

https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/36/2/1504604650-amazones-02.jpg

For the first time in the history of Blood Bowl, spice up your matches with teams made up of a combination of players from different races, or go wild and lead a team of Star Players only! 

Last but not least, we've developed a host of new features and options to enrich the already deep multiplayer experience. These expand the possibilities offered for players to communicate, create, set up and customize their online leagues and competitions.

Blood Bowl 2: Legendary Edition is now available for download on PC and Mac!

Find the patch note below.

FREE LEGENDARY UPDATE
Resurrection mode - new League option (more info here).
Wissen Tournament (= Swiss Format) - new competition format (more info here)..
20 new Star Players (more than 50 in total).
Dice overview at the end of a match.
New skills behaviour:
Kick: You can now see where the ball will land with and without the use of kick, and choose if you use the skill or not accordingly.
Side Step: The skill is optional in case of chain-push.
Grab: You can choose not to use the skill if you can crowdsurf an opponent by not using it.
New option to make some skills optional: Pass, Dodge, Tackle, Fend, Tentacles, Break Tackle.
GUI improvements
Option to display tooltip in dice probability.
FAME displayed in match.
Confirmation pop-up when conceding.
New Coach view displaying only the acquired skills.
New dice log option to display more details (all the modifiers).
Option to spend 50k gold to get a skill when hiring a mercenary.
Option to mute chat in a match.
Player card visually evolving with player's level.
New admin tools (ageing option in singleplayer, league blacklist, mixed AI/players league, manual seeding in competition, enhanced match administration).
AI/human mixed competitions (up to 8 AIs).
League chat (PC/Mac only).
You can now save & quit in a singleplayer game.
Post-match chat.
Free camera mode.
Multiplayer pause system.
Option to deactivate ageing in singleplayer league.
AI enhancement.
Cosmetic enhancements.
Overall game speed increased by 10%.
New blue Disturbing Presence visual effect when both teams have a player with that skill.
You can now fire a player directly from the roster page.
New pop-up explaining how the penalties work.
Tweak to the inducement system: cash spent by the overdog bringing the team below the 150k limit is given to the underdog team.
Cosmetic enhancements (better display of cyrilic, camera shaking when a big blitzes, new image for babes in inducements...).
BUG FIXES

notes.title: Legendary Edition is coming!
notes.content:
https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/06/1486634179-bb2-legendaryedition-logo.jpg

Hey coaches,

The Legendary Edition of Blood Bowl 2 has been announced at Le What's Next de Focus, our press event last week. We're pleased to finally unveil all the info about this new edition!

Release date

2017 – we’re aiming at this summer but depending on how the tests go, it may be delayed. We have some complicated features on the list (rez mode for example) and we want to implement them correctly. We'd prefer a slight delay than a messy launch.

Price
For new players: the Legendary Edition with ALL the content of Blood Bowl 2 at the price of a full game. It contains:
 BB2 base game
Team Pack (Wood Elf/Lizardmen/Nurgle/Norse/Necromantic/Undead/Chaos Dwarfs/Khemri)
Official Expansion.
For existing owners of BB2: the Official Expansion content for the price of a big DLC.

You'll still be able to purchase individual races if you wish.

Compatibility

Full compatibility between the 2 versions. Most small features and quality of life changes will be available to all BB2 players, even those who didn't purchase the Official Expansion.

Content of the Official Expansion
8 new races
Amazons
Goblins
Vampires
Ogres
Halflings
Pro Elves
Underworld
Kislev (based on the rules of Slanns)
For a total of 24 races (the current 14 + Chaos Dwarfs + Khemri + 8 new)
Swiss system competition
Resurrection Mode
No lasting SPP/injuries between each round.
Evolution of teams between each round set in TV.
Team Editor
Choose a race and get unlimited gold, as well as the option to add any skill/stat/injury.
These teams get a tag “custom team” which can be banned from a league.
Our goal with the combo “team editor + resurrection mode + Swiss system” is to give the opportunity to players to experience the rules played on tabletop.
New solo campaign mode
Any race.
Perpetual campaign.
You have a map where you can go from a competition to another.
Less cinematics/story and more freedom.
A brand new stadium based on the “Khemri” theme
Mercenary teams
Teams composed of players picked from different races.
Several groups of teams you can pick your players from (i.e “Elf team” = Pro Elf, WE, HE, DE).
These teams will also have a specific tag – they won’t be allowed in Champion Ladder for example.
Star Player team
Teams composed of 16 Starplayers.
These teams will have a specific tag as well.
New chat tab in a league
Accessible by all coaches with a team registered in the league.
Post-match chat
You can discuss with your opponent even after the end of the game, as long as you stay on the “end of the match” screen.
Manual seeding in competitions.
Possibility to play a league with a mix of human players and AI teams.
AI enhancement
The AI will now takes into account the current turn of the game (and not cross the pitch with dwarfs at turn 16).
Optional skills
It’s been discussed a lot with the community – more skills will be optional (Kick, Pass, Grab, Side Step, Dodge, Tackle, Fend, Tentacles, Stand Firm, Break Tackle).
Free Camera Mode
Save during a singleplayer match.
Option to deactivate ageing in solo.
Enhanced Competition Administration
Possibility to admin a match in details (to decide TDs, injuries, SPP…)
A pause system in multiplayer
3 pauses per player per game.
No time limit to a pause.
Any player can unpause at anytime during a pause (even 5 seconds after a player paused).
Players can use the chat during the pause.
FAME displayed during a match
New cheerleader models (not one per team, but a bit more diversity).
Cheerleaders will have the same colors as the team they're supporting.
Option to display the tooltip in dices probability (“2+” instead of “83%”).
A lot more Starplayers
We aim at 50 Starplayers total.
They won't all have a "premium skin" but we want to make them all available gameplay-wise.
Option to mute chat in match
Option to ban players from a competition in-game.
A lot of other small things – mainly “quality of life” improvements.
95% of the content of the Legendary Edition is directly taken from your feedback and suggestions about Blood Bowl 2 since launch. Thanks for being this commited and enthusiastic toward Blood Bowl!

A few screenshots to ease your wait! The bear is Kislev's big guy :)

https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/06/1486637495-goblinlooney-bombardier.jpg

https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/06/1486637495-kislevtamebear02.jpg

https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/06/1486637495-goblinpogoer.jpg

Have fun on the pitch,
Netheos

notes.content:

Hey Coaches, 

We're pleased to announce that the Necromantic team is now available!

The console version of the update is currently going through the certification process and should arrive in a few weeks. 

This new update features several other changes (e.g an option to disable the auto focus of the camera during the opponent turn), as well as a brand new system for the official ladder system of the game!

A new head is available for the Ghoul.
The Dark Elf Starplayer Horkon has now a unique skin.

notes.title: Undead Team Now Available!
notes.content:

Hey Coaches,

We're pleased to announce the release of a new update!

The open ladder of the Cabalvision Official League has been reset with the release of the update.

Thanks for your feedback during the Undead open beta. We gathered them and will now work on them for the next update.

Here are the patch notes of today's update:

New features
The Undead team is now available with the Starplayers Ramtut III, Count Luthor Von Drakenborg and Earlice.
A new roster interface is available. It combines the team and staff management in one page.
The price of the Orc Blitzer is now 80k.
The bretonnian blitzer has now access to agility skills on a standard level up (no doubles).
Increase of the maximum team number per coach (40 instead of 25)
Increase of the maximum competition number in a league (20 instead of 8)
Matchmaking system prameters changes (processing time: 5min / Max TV difference: 500)

Bug fixes
Fix of an issue preventing the Xbox One controller from working on Windows 10
Fix of a bug blocking a team slot
Pass Block is now usable on a Long Bomb
The coaches assistants are now properly taken into account for the kick-off event Brilliant Coaching
Fix of a crash when trying a pass outside of the pitch in BB1 control mode
Fix of a scrolling issue during inducement in hotseat with the combo mouse/controller
Fix of a bug preventing the Norse AI from validating its placement with Starplayers
The ball is now displayed properly during a Touchdown with some players
Fix of an issue preventing the screen resolution to be saved on Mac
Fix of an issue preventing players from using the chat in multiplayer on Mac
Fix of an issue preventing the random selection of a stadium in matchmaking.

notes.title: The Undead DLC is coming!
notes.content:
http://focus-files.com/presskit/bloodbowl2/screenshots/Bloodbowl2-18.jpg

Meet the upcoming Undead team and their deadly Players, all included in the Undead DLC available late July for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC/Mac.

You can still benefit from the FOUNDERS INCENTIVE: Players will receive the Undead, as well as the Necromantic and the Nurgle teams for free, as long as they purchased the game before the races release. 

Also, Blood Bowl 2 is currently 60% off on Steam until July 4th. This is a perfect opportunity to get the game at an attractive price, and receive the coming races for free as soon as they are available. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/236690/extras/STEAM-Banner-Founders-Incentive-After-the-NORSE.jpg?t=1467280553

Last but not least, all the PC/Mac owners of Blood Bowl 2 will have access to a Beta next week featuring the upcoming Undead and several updates and improvements.

The Undead Team

http://focus-files.com/presskit/bloodbowl2/screenshots/Bloodbowl2-20.jpg

Death comes often for Blood Bowl players, and the souls of the most passionate sometimes rise up again to relive the scenes of their former glory. The Undead team, raised by the Liche-lords of the Old World, have the unique skill “Regenerate” which makes them incredibly difficult to kill. They have incredibly agile pieces, the Ghouls and the Wights, but they are often too fast for their shambling, but fearsome, Mummy players to keep up. 

http://focus-files.com/presskit/bloodbowl2/screenshots/Bloodbowl2-19.jpg

Finally, two Star Players are joining the Undead: Ramtut III is a mighty and powerful mummy who has spent countless years on the pitch. Morg n’ Thorg, someone who has faced Ramtut on the pitch and lived, happens to be his sworn nemesis. Count Luthor Von Drakenborg the vampire carries impressive stats and the Hypnotic Gaze ability, and is one of our most fearsome Star Players yet! 

Soon to come, the Necromantic and the Nurgle! Stay tuned, sports fans!

http://focus-files.com/presskit/bloodbowl2/screenshots/Bloodbowl2-21.jpg

notes.title: Norse Community Update
notes.content:
Hey Coaches!

We've been super busy lately, so we thought it time to update you on what we have coming!

February was packed, with the last updates on consoles and launching the Blood Bowl 2 World Cup 2016!

We're excited to announce that over 3000 unique players have registered for our World Cup. The community leagues have now started, along with the World Cup ladder which gives the opportunity for numerous players to showcase their skills. On the forum, you can find the current leaderboard for season 1.

Our next focus is on the Norse team, as well as several key features requested by the community.

With regards to the Norse team, as we’ve announced on other networks we are currently aiming at a release in the coming weeks.

The models and animations are ready, and the team is now undergoing numerous tests for polish. Check out this screenshot by the QA team working on our beloved Norse!

 http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/10/1457358607-bb2-norse-1.jpg

The other announced teams are coming in the following months. Don't expect one team each month, but we’re aiming for it to not take as long as the Norse have. 

Our primary goal after release was to iron out the game according to community feedback. A lot has changed, with several major updates, and we'll now focus on the additional races (although we are still working on community feedback!).

Concerning the awaited features, we’re also pleased to announce a new matchmaking system based on the TV++, along with new Starplayers for the current races and numerous bug fixes, which will be implemented with the Norse update.

Developed with the help of several deeply-involved players in the community, such as Dode and Enarion, the new matchmaking system should have a positive impact on the ladder environments, especially on the Cabalvision Official League. We'll be writing up a more detailed post on the official forum in the coming days regarding its functionality.

Have fun on the pitch,
Focus Home Interactive & Cyanide Studio

notes.title: The World Cup 2016 has started!
notes.content:
Dear coaches,

We are thrilled to officially announce the start of the 2016 Blood Bowl 2 World Cup for PC players on Thursday, February 11th! 

http://focus-files.com/newsletters/2016_01_15_bloodbowl2/images/header.jpg
 
If you registered for one of the official community league qualifiers, please refer to your league commissioner.

If you want to participate in the public qualifier, you can enter now into the first season of the “Official World Cup Ladder” in-game league. The 5 best teams at the end of each season will be qualified for the Play-Off. Be careful to respect the rules of the competition. 

Quick reminder for the Official World Cup Ladder:
1.	If your Coach name isn’t registered at the end of the season, you can’t qualify even if your team is in the top five. 
2.	Any team with more than 20 games will be disqualified.
3.	Any coach with more than 5 concessions in a season (1 month), regardless of the team, will be disqualified from the current season.

The first season ends on March 11th.

Don’t forget to register yourselves HERE.
Read more information about the rules HERE.

Good luck and see you on the pitch!
Cyanide Studio & Focus Home Interactive

notes.title: Own Blood Bowl 2? 4 future races for free!
notes.content:
Hey coaches,
 
Aside our decision to offer 4 races to come to players who currently own Blood Bowl 2 for free (more info here), we are happy to unveil today the content of the newest update for the game, bringing loads of improvements and many awaited features.

You can find the full patchlog of today's update here, but here is a sneak-peek:
- Coach View: you can now activate the coach view and display a grid on the field along with a lot of other strategic information.
- Teleport will now replace players movements during the set-up phase.
- Extended dice logs: you can now open the dice logs by clicking it, to display more information about the previous actions.
- The Juggernaut skill is now optional on a ‘Both Down’ result.
- AI speed has been improved.
- A new statistic tab has been added for all players.
- You can now reconnect to a match after a crash.

Thank you once again for your continued feedback and support on Blood Bowl 2. That helps a lot!
See you on the pitch, and tell us what you think about these improvements.
 
Cyanide Studio & Focus Home Interactive

notes.title: WELCOME TO THE BETA
notes.content:
Hello Blood Bowl coaches!

We’re excited to announce that the Blood Bowl 2 multiplayer beta is now live. That means you’re able to jump in and play the game right away and start earning XP for your coaches, and developing your teams. Yup, that means that your saves, teams, and coaches will not be deleted upon launch. 

The following content will be available during the multiplayer beta – and remember, it’s exactly that: a beta. We’d love to hear your feedback, technical issues, bug reporting and anything else you’d like to share with us. The right places to do that would be the Steam Hub and the game’s official forum. 

Content in the multiplayer beta:

• Four races: Orc, Humans, Dwarfs, and Skaven
• Friendly games, local, online – against AI or players
• Multiplayer leagues
• Management: team and league creation, levelling up, earning XP etc…
• Cabal TV (that’s the game’s replay mode to help you reflect on, and analyze, your game and games from other players).

Remember, this is a real beta so we really value your feedback. Play as much multiplayer as you can and create a league with your friend! There’s no NDA, so feel free to stream and discuss your impressions about the game online and with Focus and Cyanide who’ll be eagerly scanning over your feedback. There is a list of known issues that we’re working on before launch, and these are below:

• Some players might experience performance quirks depending on their hardware – still working on optimization
• In very rare cases, certain skills used in conjunction with others may cause issues – these are known, and will be fixed for launch.
• Delay in action after Always Hungry fails by about 10 seconds.
• Minor UI tweaks are in the works. 

You’re playing before launch – during crunch time – so there’s still work to be done. This is quite normal, so don’t feel as though this is indicative of the final quality of the game. If you encounter a problem, let us know, and we’ll get on it (it’s probably something we’re already working on).

For new players, a handy guide can be found here (this is not the final version): http://guide.bloodbowl-game.com/

If you encounter technical issues (no personal feedbacks), please post it on our dedicated forum: http://forum.bloodbowl-game.com/viewforum.php?f=90
To help us identify and fix them as fast as possible, make sure to include as many information, crash reports, replay, ... as possible.

That’s about all you need to know before jumping in – so, jump in!

Have fun,

Cyanide Studios & Focus Home Interactive.
